title: RS_MinConvexHull
description: >
  Returns the footprint of the raster's data pixels: the polygon over the
  smallest pixel-aligned rectangle of the grid that holds every pixel not equal
  to its band's nodata value. Returns null if no pixel holds data.
kernels:
  - returns: geometry
    args: [raster]
  - returns: geometry
    args:
    - raster
    - name: band
      type: integer
      description: >
        Band index (1-based). When omitted, a pixel holds data if any band
        holds data there.
---

## Description

`RS_MinConvexHull` is `RS_ConvexHull` with the nodata margin trimmed off. The
rectangle is aligned to the raster's grid, so on a rotated or skewed raster the
result follows the grid axes, like `RS_ConvexHull`. A band without a nodata
value holds data everywhere, so it spans the whole grid. Only 2-D rasters are
supported.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_MinConvexHull(RS_Example());
```

```sql
SELECT RS_MinConvexHull(RS_Example(), 1);
```
